// diagnostic

E1004

Unknown item in core module

What

Unknown item in core module

Why

An import from a core module must name an item that module declares

Fix

Use a declared item from the core module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1004: tests/ui/compute_extended/raw_kernel_contract_cannot_be_forged_without_a_provider.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownCoreItem]: `core.compute` has no item `raw_kernel_contract`
  --> tests/ui/compute_extended/raw_kernel_contract_cannot_be_forged_without_a_provider.jet:2:21
    |
  2 | run: fn() { compute.raw_kernel_contract("no gate", 1) }
    |                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Standard library modules expose a fixed set of public items
 Fix: Use one of: ComputeDevice, ComputeError, ComputeStream, SparseTensor, Tensor, VJPRun, abs, add, broadcast_to, deserialize, det, device, device_auto, device_cpu, device_cuda, device_metal, device_vulkan, device_webgpu, div, exp, eye, fft, from_list, full, get, gradient, inv, jvp, kernel_bounds_ok, log, matmul, matmul_f32_tile, matrix, maximum, minimum, mul, negate, numel, on_device, ones, placement, profile_f32_strict, profile_show, rank, reshape, serialize, set, shape, solve, sparse_mv, sparse_nnz, sparse_show, sqrt, stream_new, stream_new_on, stream_show, stream_sync, sub, sum, sum_axis, to_list, to_sparse, transfer, transfer_show, transpose, value_and_gradient, vec, vjp, zeros
